target.title: feat(whatsapp): add requester-bound MeowCaller calls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp-connected agents cannot place a WhatsApp voice call back to the person who triggered a turn. This adds an experimental, requester-bound call tool for audible task-completion or urgent notifications.

Closes #99634

## Why This Change Was Made

The WhatsApp plugin now registers `whatsapp_call` only for WhatsApp-originated turns carrying trusted requester context. The tool accepts a message but no destination, resolves the requester from inbound identity, synthesizes telephony TTS, and invokes a separately paired MeowCaller companion with fixed `notify` argv.

The `notify` contract is intentionally send-only. MeowCaller's current `play` command opens a speaker and receives peer audio, so this PR stays draft until the upstream CLI adds `notify` without any receive path.

## User Impact

After installing a compatible MeowCaller CLI, pairing its separate linked-device session, and configuring TTS, a user can message: `Call me and say the build finished.`

Boundaries:

- calls only the current WhatsApp requester
- rejects self-calls and concurrent calls for one account
- supports PCM and current mu-law telephony TTS outputs
- limits synthesized audio to 60 seconds
- deletes private temporary audio after each attempt
- reports call placement only when the companion emits its placement marker

No new OpenClaw config or environment variables.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/agent-tools-call.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/index.test.ts` — 13/13 passed after rebase
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwmpmfevzstp3dsgzp1sb3ps` — `pnpm check:changed` passed
- Same Testbox — `pnpm test:extension whatsapp`, 86 files and 997/997 tests passed
- [Testbox Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28679424238)
- Autoreview accepted and drove fixes for send-only invocation, mu-law TTS conversion, and overlong audio. Final rerun reports one intentional draft blocker: no accessible upstream MeowCaller revision implements `notify` yet.

Live call proof: pending. Current upstream MeowCaller lacks the required send-only `notify` command. End-to-end proof also requires a freshly paired linked device and recipient E.164. This PR is intentionally draft until those prerequisites are complete.
